basic_details.job_title: IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate II (CSE) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar) has invited applications for the position of Project Associate-II under the CSE department for the research project titled "SecStand: Security and Standardization of 6G Systems," funded by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India. There are 4 positions available with a consolidated monthly remuneration ranging from ₹50,000/- to ₹90,000/-. Eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the official portal by 06/11/2026.

how_to_apply: Visit the official application portal at http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/.
Submit your application online by the last date of application submission 06/11/2026.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate-II
content_sections.text: This recruitment drive is conducted by the Research & Development Office at the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar under Principal Investigator Prof. Sameer Kulkarni (Mail Id: [email protected] ). The appointed candidates will work on investigating broader security concerns of 6th generation telecom networks and designing solutions to address them. The position is temporary and tied directly to the SecStand 6G Systems project funded by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 positions are available for the Project Associate-II designation under the Computer Science and Engineering department. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualifications governed by Institute norms as specified in the notification. A higher cutoff level may be used, and merely meeting minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee shortlisting and/or appointment.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Tech./M.S./M.Phil. or equivalent qualification in Computer Science and Engineering or an appropriate discipline; OR B.Tech./B.E./M.Sc./M.C.A./LLM./CA/CMA/CS/MBA/Professional qualification or equivalent in an appropriate discipline with a minimum of 02 years of post-qualification experience; OR B.C.A./B.Sc./B.A./B.Com./B.B.A./LLB. or equivalent qualification in an appropriate discipline with a minimum of 06 years of post-qualification experience in Teaching/Research/Industrial/Design and Development/IT/Administration in an organization/Industry of repute. (The percentage/grade points with respect to the academic qualification will be a minimum 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th.)
rows.desirable_qualification: Candidates having knowledge of Computer Networks, Wireless Communications, Working Knowledge with Linux Systems and willing to pursue Ph.D at IIT Gandhinagar will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly remuneration is ₹50,000/- to ₹90,000/- per month (consolidated including HRA). House Rent Allowance per month (If applicable) is N.A. The duration of the appointment is 01 year or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate-II Job Description
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from motivated and eligible candidates for the position of Project Associate-II in a research project titled "SecStand: Security and Standardization of 6G Systems", funded by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India. The core objectives of the project include: This project aims to investigate broader security concerns of 6th generation telecom networks and design solutions to address the security concerns.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate-II
content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal at http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/. Submit your application online by the last date of application submission 06/11/2026.
